verdict.rationale: First-party docs say teams can review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events and failures after work runs. The Workforce Agents area is described as the place to investigate a tool call, review a session or check how an agent connected. Activity logs are positioned as a core platform feature and are kept separately per environment. Missing for 10: documentation of what each tool-call record contains (arguments, responses, actor, timestamps), any evidence of replay or export, explicit confirmation that every call is captured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
